inputs.commit_message: chore: deep inspect local p2p-link R2 updater
inputs.shell_command: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=/home/hesham/p2p-link; cd "$ROOT"; echo '=== DEEP R2 UPDATE STUDY ==='; echo '--- all actual matches including untracked ---'; rg -n -i --hidden --glob '!.git/**' --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!.env*' --glob '!r2.env' --glob '!*.pem' --glob '!*.key' '(device-link/peers\.json|publish_registry|put_object|R2|cloudflare|3600|sleep[ (]|hourly|every hour|every_hour|timer|cron|heartbeat|refresh|update.*server|server.*update|sync.*peer|peer.*sync)' . 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)[^A-Za-z0-9_]/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -500 || true; echo '--- tracked local diff ---'; git diff -- docs/README.md p2p_link/config.py 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -500 || true; echo '--- config structure ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/config.py | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -220; echo '--- engine publish loop ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/engine.py | sed -n '55,125p'; echo '--- registry implementation ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/registry.py | sed -n '1,130p'; echo '--- R2 client implementation (credential lines suppressed) ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/r2_client.py | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -180; echo '--- netinfo implementation ---'; nl -ba p2p_link/netinfo.py | head -180; echo '--- untracked r2_credentials structure ---'; if [ -f p2p_link/r2_credentials.py ]; then nl -ba p2p_link/r2_credentials.py | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -240; fi; echo '--- migrate script ---'; if [ -f scripts/migrate-r2-credentials.sh ]; then nl -ba scripts/migrate-r2-credentials.sh | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -240; fi; echo '--- docs commands/operations ---'; nl -ba docs/README.md | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -180; echo '--- launcher files ---'; for f in p2p-link.desktop scripts/install-launcher.sh scripts/p2p-link-gui.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "### $f"; nl -ba "$f" | head -220; done; echo '--- running processes from p2p-link ---'; ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -F '/home/hesham/p2p-link' | grep -v grep | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking process suppressed]#' || true; echo '--- scheduler references by absolute path ---'; for d in /home/hesham/.config/systemd/user /home/hesham/.local/share/systemd/user /etc/systemd/system /home/hesham/.config/autostart /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.daily; do [ -e "$d" ] || continue; echo "### $d"; grep -RniF '/home/hesham/p2p-link' "$d" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -120 || true; done; echo '--- scheduler semantic matches ---'; for d in /home/hesham/.config/systemd/user /home/hesham/.local/share/systemd/user /etc/systemd/system /home/hesham/.config/autostart; do [ -e "$d" ] || continue; grep -RniE '(device-link/peers\.json|p2p_link|p2p-link|publish_registry|R2)' "$d" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -160 || true; done; echo '--- user shell startup references (no values) ---'; for f in /home/hesham/.bashrc /home/hesham/.bash_aliases /home/hesham/.profile /home/hesham/.zshrc; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; grep -nEi '(p2p-link|p2p_link|device-link/peers|R2)' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sed -E '/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|SECRET|ACCESS_KEY|AUTHORIZATION|CREDENTIAL)/I s#^.*$#[sensitive-looking line suppressed]#' | head -100 || true; done; echo '--- systemd user environment summary ---'; systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(p2p|peer|r2)' || true; systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== END DEEP STUDY ==='
